title: Design System: Bright Pocket VPN Operational Ledger

title.purpose: Workspace, analytics, dialog, card, and profile headings.

body.purpose: Body copy, tables, fields, chart text, timestamps, and operational values.

label.purpose: Actions, navigation, field labels, badges, and structural captions.

measurement.purpose: Transfer, speed, duration, quota, and other numeric results.

shadows.name: feature-lift
shadows.purpose: Reserved for the customer connection proof and primary customer panels.

shadows.name: ledger-lift
shadows.purpose: Reserved for customer plan or profile objects; operational analytics stays flat.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Visible keyboard focus with cream separation on light surfaces.

motion.name: status-breathe

motion.name: state-brightness

components.name: Compact Primary Button
components.description: The default admin and operational action with a 44px target.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; background: var(--purple, #6d28d9); color: #fff; font: 800 13px/1 'Anybody', ui-rounded, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; font-variation-settings: 'wdth' 82, 'wght' 800; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.95); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--purple, #6d28d9); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--cream, #fff8e8); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: An outlined alternative that retains equal target size and focus visibility.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; background: transparent; color: var(--deep-purple, #30105f); outline: 2px solid var(--deep-purple, #30105f); outline-offset: -2px; font: 800 13px/1 'Anybody', ui-rounded, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { filter: brightness(.95); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--purple, #6d28d9); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--cream, #fff8e8); }

components.name: Labeled Field
components.description: The shared persistent-label field for selectors, forms, and admin edits.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink, #24113f); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field > span { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 850; } .ds-field select { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #dfd1e9); border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #24113f); font: inherit; } .ds-field select:focus-visible { border-color: var(--purple, #6d28d9); outline: 3px solid rgb(109 40 217 / 18%); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-field select:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: A scrollable admin destination strip with an explicit active workspace.
components.html: <nav class="ds-workspace-nav" aria-label="Admin workspace"><button aria-current="page">VPN users</button><button>Storefront customers</button><button>Usage history</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-workspace-nav { display: flex; gap: 5px; overflow-x: auto; padding: 4px 0; } .ds-workspace-nav button { flex: 0 0 auto; min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 9px 14px; background: transparent; color: var(--deep-purple, #30105f); font: 800 13px/1 'Anybody', ui-rounded, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-workspace-nav button:hover { background: #efe6f6; } .ds-workspace-nav button[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--purple, #6d28d9); color: #fff; } .ds-workspace-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--purple, #6d28d9); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--cream, #fff8e8); }

components.name: Usage Range Control
components.description: An equal-weight range group with a redundant pressed state.
components.css: .ds-ranges { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-ranges button { min-width: 64px; min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 9px 14px; background: #fff; color: var(--deep-purple, #30105f); outline: 2px solid var(--line, #dfd1e9); outline-offset: -2px; font: 800 13px/1 'Anybody', ui-rounded, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ranges button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--purple, #6d28d9); color: #fff; outline-color: var(--purple, #6d28d9); } .ds-ranges button:hover { filter: brightness(.95); } .ds-ranges button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--purple, #6d28d9); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--cream, #fff8e8); }

components.name: Usage Metric Tile
components.description: A yellow factual summary tile for transfer, peak speed, or connected time.
components.css: .ds-metric { min-width: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; background: var(--yellow, #f8d928); color: var(--ink, #24113f); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-metric h3 { margin: 0 0 5px; color: var(--deep-purple, #30105f); font: 850 12px/1.2 'Anybody', ui-rounded, sans-serif; } .ds-metric p { margin: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.15; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metric:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--purple, #6d28d9); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-table-scroll { max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--paper, #fffdf7); color: var(--ink, #24113f); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-table { width: 100%; min-width: 700px; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; } .ds-table th { padding: 12px 9px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #dfd1e9); color: var(--muted, #705f80); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; text-align: left; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table td { padding: 10px 9px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eee6f2; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-table-scroll:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--purple, #6d28d9); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (max-width: 520px) { .ds-table-scroll { overflow: visible; background: transparent; } .ds-table, .ds-table tbody { display: block; min-width: 0; } .ds-table thead { display: none; } .ds-table tr { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px 12px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--paper, #fffdf7); } .ds-table td { display: block; padding: 4px 0; border: 0; } .ds-table td::before { content: attr(data-label); display: block; margin-bottom: 3px; color: var(--muted, #705f80); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 850; text-transform: uppercase; } }

components.name: Accessible Usage Chart
components.description: The solid-upload/dashed-download plot with explicit scale, time, legend, and prose context.
components.css: .ds-chart { min-width: 0; margin: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line, #dfd1e9); border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #24113f); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-scale { margin: 0 0 4px; color: var(--muted, #705f80); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 750; } .ds-chart svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; min-height: 140px; max-height: 260px; overflow: visible; } .ds-chart path { fill: none; stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-upload { stroke: var(--purple, #6d28d9); } .ds-download { stroke: var(--deep-purple, #30105f); stroke-dasharray: 7 5; } .ds-times { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding-top: 4px; color: var(--muted, #705f80); font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-chart figcaption { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px 18px; padding-top: 12px; color: var(--muted, #705f80); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-chart figcaption span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; } .ds-chart figcaption strong { flex: 1 1 100%; color: var(--muted, #705f80); font-weight: 500; } .ds-key { width: 18px; height: 0; border-top: 3px solid var(--purple, #6d28d9); } .ds-key-download { border-top: 3px dashed var(--deep-purple, #30105f); }

components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(900px, 100%); max-height: min(88vh, 900px); overflow: auto; border-radius: 16px; padding: 22px; background: var(--paper, #fffdf7); color: var(--ink, #24113f); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-dialog header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-dialog h2 { margin: 0; font: 800 21px/1.1 'Anybody', ui-rounded, 'Avenir Next', sans-serif; } .ds-dialog p { color: var(--muted, #705f80); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-dialog button { min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; background: transparent; color: var(--deep-purple, #30105f); outline: 2px solid var(--deep-purple, #30105f); outline-offset: -2px; font: 800 13px/1 'Anybody', ui-rounded, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog button:hover { filter: brightness(.95); } .ds-dialog button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--purple, #6d28d9); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--cream, #fff8e8); }

narrative.overview:
Bright Pocket turns VPN purchase, device management, and usage analytics into one warm, legible ledger. Cream is the workspace, paper surfaces hold the record, purple identifies structure and action, and yellow makes selected offers or key measurements easy to find. The visual language is colorful without becoming ornamental: every field, control, number, and chart exists to help a customer understand service or an administrator complete a targeted operation.

The customer storefront, customer dashboard, and private admin intentionally share this system. Their density changes with the job: persuasive customer surfaces may use large compressed statements and generous fields; customer analytics becomes calmer and explanatory; private admin is the densest, most task-first expression, using desktop tables where comparison benefits and cards when the viewport narrows. Shared identity never means identical composition.

Visual convergence does not change product boundaries. Customer identity and VPN data remain private, analytics appears only for eligible profiles, and admin actions must preserve the live VPN through targeted operations rather than implying or requiring a broad restart or interface reload.
keyCharacteristics: Cream canvas, paper work surfaces, purple structure/actions, and yellow metrics/emphasis.
Anybody reserved for brand, headings, navigation, and actions; system UI for body, tables, fields, timestamps, and measurements.
Compact 12–16px operational curves, flat tonal grouping, and sparse soft elevation on customer promotional objects.
Desktop tables for dense comparison; responsive record cards and stacked analytics below tablet widths.
Charts with real timestamp spacing, explicit max/zero/time context, redundant line styles, and complete text summaries.
Controls at least 44px high, visible focus, semantic status text, and reduced-motion behavior.

rules.name: The Yellow Is a Fact Rule
rules.body: Yellow marks an offer, count, summary, or other high-value fact; it is never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Status Means Status Rule
rules.body: Green and red communicate connection, success, failure, or destructive intent and never substitute for brand color.

rules.name: The Two-Purple Chart Rule
rules.body: Upload uses solid Action Purple; download uses dashed Anchor Purple. Labels and the text summary repeat the distinction so color is never the only key.

rules.name: The Brand on the Frame Rule
rules.body: Anybody belongs on the frame—brand, headings, navigation, and actions—not inside the data being operated on.

rules.name: The Numbers Stay Native Rule
rules.body: Measurements, timestamps, IP addresses, quotas, and table values use system UI with tabular numerals where available; do not introduce decorative monospace merely to look technical.

rules.name: The Table Until It Stops Helping Rule
rules.body: Keep a table while side-by-side comparison is faster; switch the record to labeled cards before density becomes horizontal friction.

rules.name: The Context Around the Plot Rule
rules.body: A chart is incomplete without scale, zero baseline, time range, timezone-aware labels, legend, state text, and a prose summary.

rules.name: The Flat Operations Rule
rules.body: Tables, metric tiles, charts, navigation, and dialogs rely on tonal fields and borders at rest; do not make every record float.

rules.name: The Straight Workflow Rule
rules.body: Data, controls, charts, tables, and dialogs remain level; tilt belongs only to the isolated customer proof object.

dos: Do use this shared ledger language across customer and private admin surfaces, adjusting density to the job rather than creating a separate admin brand.
Do use Anybody only for brand, headings, navigation, and actions; keep body, tables, fields, timestamps, and measurements in system UI.
Do preserve exact plan, quota, speed, duration, payment, transfer, and connection facts.
Do pair every usage chart with max/zero/time context, solid-versus-dashed series, accessible SVG naming, and a visible text summary.
Do keep controls at least 44px, keyboard focus visible, status understandable without color, and motion removable.
Do use targeted, recoverable admin feedback that preserves live VPN availability and customer privacy.
donts: Don't reintroduce the legacy dark admin theme or fork admin into an unrelated visual system; its distinction comes from density and task priority.
Don't use gradients, glass effects, decorative blur, gratuitous shadow, or marketing-scale display type inside operational data.
Don't space chart points equally when valid timestamps are available or omit the zero baseline, time context, timezone, legend, or textual equivalent.
Don't turn a desktop table into horizontal page overflow on smaller screens; transform records into labeled cards when comparison no longer helps.
Don't expose customer analytics outside the eligible profile boundary or let an admin control imply a broad VPN restart/reload.
Don't invent benchmarks, testimonials, server-location claims, payment imagery, or other unsupported product facts.
